newsitem.title: USA: LCC to restate Q4 results lower for charge.
newsitem.headline: LCC to restate Q4 results lower for charge.

text.p: LCC International Inc, a telecommunications engineering firm, said on Wednesday that it intends to restate its 1996 fourth quarter and annual results to reflect a charge for certain receivables and investments.
LCC's proforma loss per share for the fourth quarter widened to $1.31 a share from the $0.01 loss it previously reported, LCC said.
For the year, LCC intends to restate its 1996 proforma results to a loss of $1.19 a share from a previously reported profit of $0.30 a share.

LCC president and chief executive Piyush Sodha said in a statement: "We expect operating earnings in the first half of 1997 to be below those reported for the first half of 1996. More importantly, however, the company expects to report an increase in operating profits in both the third and fourth quarters of 1997."

Pocket Communications failed to pay interest due to LCC under a $6.5 million convertible debenture and interest due under a $900,000 note and sought Chapter 11, LCC said. LCC's exposure to Pocket Communications is $9.6 million, as of March 31, 1997.
